name: comfyui
description: Create, edit, validate, run and download complete ComfyUI workflows with dynamic local-file and prompt inputs

tools.name: comfyui_nodes
tools.description: Discover real installed ComfyUI node classes before building a workflow. With node_class, get exact required/optional input schemas, current model/file choices, output types and output slot indices. Otherwise search a bounded catalog page. Build complete connected API graphs with an output node; do not invent node names, model filenames or universal media support. Configuration: COMFYUI_BASE_URL or custom_data.comfyui_workflow_base_url.

node_class.description: Exact class name to inspect; mutually exclusive with catalog filters

tools.name: comfyui_workflow
tools.description: Create, read, modify, validate and download ComfyUI workflows via server userdata API. list: saved JSON names. get: workflow JSON, sha256 and downloadable local file. save: create a complete API or editor graph from workflow or workflow_path; overwrite defaults false. edit: apply atomic local JSON Patch add/replace/remove/test operations, then save; requires the sha256 from get to detect stale edits (not server-side CAS). Can add/remove/reconnect nodes, edit widgets or editor layout. validate: check an API graph against installed node schemas/model choices and connections without executing. A complete workflow must have valid connections and an output node. Only a successful run verifies runtime behavior; save/edit do not install nodes/models or execute. Editor nodes/links JSON can be stored/edited but must be exported as API format before execution. Files use the existing Praxis download endpoint.

name.description: For get/save/edit: relative name under ComfyUI's workflows userdata folder, e.g. portraits/edit.api.json

workflow.description: For save/validate: complete JSON graph. API format is {node_id:{class_type,inputs}}. Editor JSON has nodes/links arrays.

workflow_path.description: For save/validate: existing local JSON file instead of workflow; relative to Praxis cwd or absolute

workflow_name.description: For validate: saved server workflow instead of workflow/workflow_path

overwrite.description: For save only: explicitly replace an existing workflow

expected_sha256.description: Required for edit: server content sha256 from the latest get

patch.description: For edit: JSON Patch, e.g. replace /6/inputs/text, add /12 node, replace /9/inputs/images connection, remove /12. Array indexes and ~0/~1 JSON pointer escapes supported.

include_workflow.description: For get: include graph JSON in the response as well as its download file

tools.name: comfyui_run
tools.description: Run a complete ComfyUI API workflow once, only when the user requests execution. Choose exactly one workflow_name (server), workflow_path (local), or workflow (inline). Explicitly bind prompt_targets, files and typed overrides; never guess positive versus negative prompt nodes or silently replace unrelated inputs. Files can be any readable regular local file, regardless of extension, uploaded unchanged via /upload/image; compatibility depends on the selected installed loader. Use an exact existing path (including an earlier downloaded attachment), not a remote URL. Reuse the returned upload descriptor, never a local path on the GPU server. Performs installed-node preflight, then queues exactly once; no retries or remote interruption. Default wait_seconds=0 returns a prompt_id immediately; use comfyui_result for completion/downloads. Running does not mutate the saved template. GPU/model/custom-node execution may cost resources or use paid nodes; no automatic node/model installation.

workflow_name.description: Saved server workflow name under workflows/, ending in .json

workflow_path.description: Path to an existing API-format JSON on the Praxis host

prompt.description: Exact text to bind to prompt_targets (required when targets are supplied); does not translate or interpolate JSON

prompt_targets.description: Required with prompt. Explicit input destinations, e.g. [{node_id:'6',input:'text'}]

files.description: Upload local inputs, binding each returned ComfyUI input filename to the given node input. Any file extension; the workflow's loader decides support. No Discord-specific constraints. Multiple references/loader nodes supported.

overrides.description: Typed node input changes for this run (seed, dimensions, negative prompt, model, connections or an existing server-side input filename). No JSON string substitution. Cannot overlap other bindings.

preflight.description: Check installed node schemas before uploading/queuing. Set false for custom dynamic schemas/VALIDATE_INPUTS not representable in object_info; ComfyUI still validates /prompt. Local format, binding and file checks always apply.

wait_seconds.description: Optional bounded wait before returning. Pending work is resumed with comfyui_result, never resubmitted.

output_nodes.description: Only download these nodes' results. Does not restrict execution of other output nodes.

tools.name: comfyui_result
tools.description: Check/wait for a previously returned ComfyUI prompt_id and download its completed files to Praxis. Never requeues a job. Handles standard filename/subfolder/type descriptors under any output key: images, audio, videos, gifs or custom files. Returns local paths and existing authenticated /api/files download links plus bounded structured outputs. Custom absolute paths/URLs are not fetched; custom output nodes must expose standard /view descriptors. Pending means queued/running or absent from retained history, not failure. Errors preserve the prompt_id so you can inspect/recover without spending again.
